title: Evidence-based literature review workflow
author: researcher_example
prompt: Review the supplied research question in stages. First list search concepts and synonyms. Then compare each supplied paper in a table with methods, sample, limitations, and findings. Flag unsupported claims, distinguish evidence from inference, cite only supplied sources, and finish with open questions and a reproducible checklist.

title: Test-driven debugging assistant prompt
author: example-author
prompt: Inspect the provided failing test and the smallest relevant code context. State the observed behavior and expected behavior separately. Propose a minimal diagnosis, ask for missing facts rather than guessing, suggest a regression test, and verify each proposed change against the stated acceptance criteria.

title: Rewrite this as a senior consultant
author: example-user
prompt: Act as a senior consultant and analyze this document.

title: Unsafe fixture excluded by security filters
